params.body:
Closes #1098

## What was wrong

When a vehicle a partner sends through the API does not get in, the platform mails the office and writes the exception to the log. That mail was the only trace:

- it goes to one address (`MAIL_API_ERROR_RECIPIENT`, else `SUPPORT_EMAIL`);
- the partner gets its error with status 200, so `api_log` holds the call as a good one and the error figures on Werking and in the `errors` read say nothing;
- the mail told the office to forward it "when it comes back", which leaves counting to whoever reads that mailbox.

So whether a partner vehicle was lost once or every day could only be answered from the office's inbox.

## What changes

- Every lost partner vehicle writes one row in a new table `api_vehicle_losses`: the cause the mail already names (storage, photo or platform) and the moment. No garage and no car; those stay in the mail.
- `Operations::api()` carries the count over 30 days, per cause, with the moment of the last one. The `errors` read returns it as `partner_vehicles_lost`, and Beheer > Werking shows it as its own line under the partner API, which also colours that line. With nothing lost the line is absent.
- Writing the count can never hide the error or stop the mail: a failure to write is logged as a warning and the rest goes on.
- `stocklist:daily` removes rows older than 90 days.
- The office mail for a storage hiccup no longer asks to forward it; it says the platform counts these itself. The mail for a fault in the platform is unchanged.

The mail itself and its recipient are untouched.

## Rules

- New: R P3-2.15 (a lost partner vehicle is counted).
- Amended: R P3-14.7 (the Werking line) and R P3-17.6 (the `errors` read).

## Tests

- New `ALostPartnerVehicleIsCountedTest`: a failing create through `/api/vehicles/create` leaves one row with the cause and still sends the mail; a create that works leaves none; the count per cause and the 30-day window; a quiet month is a zero; the count that cannot be written stops nothing; pruning at 90 days; the new mail sentence; the screen line in four languages.
- `OperationsScreenTest`: the line is absent without a loss and present with its count per cause.
- `ControlReadTest`: the `errors` read carries `partner_vehicles_lost`.
- Full suite: 3276 tests green. PHPStan: no errors.

## After merge

The migration creates `api_vehicle_losses`. Counting starts from the deploy: the loss of 14 November is not in it.
params.title: A partner's vehicle that does not get in is counted per cause
